Notifications.Title: Raid Policy
Notifications.Text: Base raiding is allowed Friday 18:00 through Monday 06:00 (server local time). Outside that window, raid tools will not work.

Notifications.Title: Raid Window Reminder
Notifications.Text: If today is Friday: raiding opens at 18:00. Weekend rule — Friday 18:00 to Monday 06:00 only.

Notifications.Title: Raid Status
Notifications.Text: Raid window: Fri 18:00–Mon 06:00. If you are inside that window, bases are fair game. If not, walls hold.

Notifications.Title: Raid Window Reminder
Notifications.Text: If today is Monday: raiding closes at 06:00. Secure your position before the window ends.

Notifications.Title: Raid Status
Notifications.Text: Outside Fri 18:00–Mon 06:00, Expansion raid tools are locked. Survive, build, and wait for the weekend.
